title.en: An Act to Make the Present Sitio of Caabiagan, of the Municipality of Paniqui, Province of Tarlac, a Barrio to Be Known as San Carlos.

text.en:
The present sitio of Caabiañgan, of the municipality of Paniqui, Province of Tarlac, is hereby
made a barrio to be known as San Carlos, and the entire territory comprised within the jurisdictional limits of
said sitio of Caabiañgan shall hereafter be known as San Carlos.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, January 6, 1933.
